name: Name
nameHint: Lowercase letters, numbers and hyphens, for example pr-review.
descriptionHint: Agents read this to decide when the skill fits a task.
descriptionPlaceholder: When the agent should use this skill
descriptionTooLong: Shorten it to 1,024 characters or fewer. Agents cannot read a longer description.
instructionsHint: The steps the agent follows when it uses this skill.
instructionsPlaceholder: Write the steps the agent follows…
nothingYet: Nothing written yet. Switch to Write to add the steps.
filesHint: Scripts, templates and examples the agent can open while it follows the instructions.
noFiles: No files yet. Add scripts, templates or examples, or drop files here.
noFilesReadOnly: This skill has only its instructions.
allowProgramsHint: Your sandbox must allow it too.
turnOnPrograms: This file runs only when “Let files run as programs” is on.
plainName: Use plain folder and file names, without . or ..
skillMdReserved: SKILL.md is the skill's own file. Choose another name.
fileExists: A file with this name already exists.
trustNote: Skills that run programs can change files and reach the internet. Add them only from sources you trust.
notARepo: Paste a link to a public GitHub repository, for example https://github.com/owner/repo.
repoNotFound: We could not find this repository. Check the link, and make sure the repository is public.
readRepoFailed: We could not read this repository.
importFailed: The import did not work. Try again.
readUploadFailed: We could not read the upload.
createFailed: The skill was not created. Try again.
